newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian base metals steady in range-bound trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian base metals steady in range-bound trade.

text.p: Indian base metals were steady in range-bound trade on Friday, dealers said.
Copper was steady at 13,900 rupees per quintal in thin trade as traders consolidated positions, they said. Copper was up 25 rupees on Thursday.
"Copper is attracting industrial enquiries at current level and may move up further," one broker said.
Nickel and tin prices were steady after recent losses as fresh industrial buying kept prices from falling further, dealers said.
Nickel was steady at 34,300 rupees per quintal after losing 200 rupees on Thursday.
Tin was unchanged at 29,600 rupees per quintal after losing 200 rupees per quintal on Thursday.
Zinc and lead were also steady at 8,150 rupees and 4,100 rupees per quintal respectivelt, dealers said.
